text_block_list.text: One day, in the central plaza...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Huh, looks like I've got a message from
my agent.
Let's see... they need me for
some detail shots
after this, huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Urk, but I have training then! Why do
these
scheduling conflicts keep
happening...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: You seem pretty busy. Everything okay?

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just you. Thanks for the concern,
but I was
the one who decided to take
all this on, so it's
fine.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
My race is coming up soon, though, so
I'm gonna
have a lot on my plate...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Focus on what's at hand for now!
Would you like an energy drink?

text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right. I don't have time to
be
indecisive.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Huh? For real? You're a lifesaver.
Showing up to a
shoot like a zombie
doesn't exactly scream
professional.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I've just gotta get things done one at a
time...
Okay, I've got this. Thanks for the
tip.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Nice, I'm ready to take on the world
now. Thanks
again for the drink. I'll do
my best at the shoot
and my race.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
